user.title: Wiser by Feller µGateway
user.description: Enter the address of the µGateway (for example `wiser-00123456.local` or its IP address).

data_description.host: Host name or IP address of the µGateway.
data_description.username: Account name created on the gateway. Claiming the same name twice replaces the old token.

discovery_confirm.title: Set up {name}
discovery_confirm.description: µGateway {sn} was found at {host}. Continue to pair Home Assistant with it.

claim.title: Press a button on the µGateway

claim_failed.title: Pairing failed
claim_failed.description: Pairing with {name} ({host}) did not work. Press Submit to try again.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-pair {name}
reauth_confirm.description: The gateway no longer accepts the stored token. A new one is created by pressing a button on the µGateway within 30 seconds.

progress.claim_press_button: Press any button on the µGateway {name} within {timeout} seconds. Its LEDs flash purple while it waits. Rooms and names are copied from the Wiser app automatically.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the gateway.
error.not_wiser_gateway: This host does not look like a Wiser µGateway.
error.claim_timeout: No button was pressed in time.
error.api_locked: The gateway rejected the request (API locked).
error.no_site_info: The gateway has no site information yet. Finish the setup in the Wiser app first.
error.invalid_source: None of the known accounts exist on this gateway.

abort.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the gateway.
abort.not_wiser_gateway: This host does not look like a Wiser µGateway.
abort.wrong_device: The address belongs to a different gateway.

data.fallback_click_pause_ms: Pause between tilt clicks when the step duration is unknown
data.tilt_settle_ms: Settle time before verifying the tilt
data.tilt_fallback_reference: Reference run if the tilt still differs
data.read_motor_config: Read the motor configuration from the devices

data_description.poll_interval: REST reconciliation interval while the websocket is connected.
data_description.tilt_mode: auto: single tilt clicks with verification; reference: always a full reference run (slower, like the Wiser app).

set_tilt_steps.name: Set tilt steps
set_tilt_steps.description: Tilts a venetian blind to a slat position in raw Wiser steps (0 = closed, 9 = horizontal). Auto mode uses single click commands relative to the current position and verifies the result.

steps.name: Steps
steps.description: Target step 0-9, or a signed delta -9..9 in relative mode.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: auto (default): clicks, reference run for 0 and as fallback. absolute: clicks only. relative: clicks by delta. reference: target_state with reference run.

max_rounds.name: Correction rounds
max_rounds.description: Overrides the integration option for this call.

wait.name: Wait
wait.description: Wait until the tilt is done (default) or return immediately.

set_target_state.name: Set target state (raw)
set_target_state.description: Sends a raw target_state to the blind: level 0-10000 (0 = fully open) and/or tilt 0-9. A tilt always includes a reference run.

load_ctrl.name: Load control (raw)
load_ctrl.description: Simulates a button press on the load (button and event as in the Wiser API). No safety checks.

button.name: Button
button.description: up, down, stop, toggle, on or off.

refresh_structure.name: Reload structure
refresh_structure.description: Reads loads, rooms, devices, scenes and buttons from the gateway again.

blind_locked.message: The blind is locked by the weather protection.

motor_learning.message: The motor is not calibrated yet; only open, close and stop are possible.

no_ctrl_support.message: {entity_id} does not support raw control commands.

tilt_unknown.message: The current tilt is unknown; use absolute or reference mode.

tilt_timeout.message: The tilt command did not finish in time.

no_target_entities.message: No Wiser by Feller entities were targeted.

negative_steps_absolute.message: Negative steps are only allowed in relative mode.

no_config_entry.message: No matching Wiser by Feller gateway is loaded.

scene_without_job.message: This scene has no job on the gateway.

gateway_serial_mismatch.title: Different gateway at {host}
gateway_serial_mismatch.description: The host {host} answers with serial number {found}, but this entry was set up for {expected}. Correct the address via Reconfigure or remove the entry.

firmware_too_old.title: µGateway firmware {version} is old
firmware_too_old.description: Wall button events need firmware {required} or newer. Update the µGateway in the Wiser app.

motor_uncalibrated.title: Blind {name} is not calibrated
motor_uncalibrated.description: The motor reports the learning flag; position and tilt are unknown until the end positions are taught in the Wiser app.

buttons_unregistered.title: {count} wall buttons do not send events

confirm.title: Register wall buttons
confirm.description: Register all sleeping buttons on the gateway so Home Assistant receives click, long-press and release events.

device_details_failed.title: Device details could not be read
device_details_failed.description: Inputs, outputs or motor configuration of {devices} could not be read. Blinds fall back to default tilt timing. Use the 'Reload motor configuration' button to retry.
